title: Space & Astronomy (Vũ trụ & Hệ Mặt trời)

questions.prompt: Which theory is most widely accepted by scientists to explain the formation of the Universe?
questions.explanation: The Big Bang Theory suggests the universe began from a singularity about 13.8 billion years ago and continues to expand.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the galaxy in which our Solar System is located?
questions.explanation: The Solar System is located in a spiral arm of the Milky Way galaxy.

questions.prompt: Which planet is the largest in our Solar System?
questions.explanation: Jupiter is the largest planet and could fit more than 1,300 Earths inside it.

questions.prompt: Which of the following units is commonly used to measure distances between stars in the Universe?
questions.explanation: A light-year is the distance light travels in one year (about 9.46 trillion km).

questions.prompt: Which planet is known as the "Red Planet" due to iron oxide on its surface?
questions.explanation: Iron oxide (rust) on the surface of Mars gives it its characteristic red color.

questions.prompt: Which astronomical object has such a strong gravitational pull that even light cannot escape from it?
questions.explanation: Black holes have an extremely dense concentration of mass, creating a gravitational field that exceeds the speed of light.

questions.prompt: Which planet is the hottest in the Solar System, even though it is not the closest to the Sun?
questions.explanation: Venus is the hottest planet (around 465°C) due to a runaway greenhouse effect from its thick CO2 atmosphere.

questions.prompt: What are the primary gases that compose the Sun and most stars?
questions.explanation: Hydrogen makes up about 73% and Helium about 25% of the Sun's mass.

questions.prompt: Approximately how many days does it take for the Moon to complete one orbit around Earth?
questions.explanation: The lunar cycle (from one full moon to the next) lasts approximately 29.5 days.

questions.prompt: Which planet in the Solar System is most famous for its extensive and bright system of ice and dust rings?
questions.explanation: Saturn features the most magnificent and extensive ring system, composed of ice particles and rock debris.
